item.tib: pad ma thugs kyi rtsa rgyud las las sbyor drag po brnag pa srog gi spu gri rno gcod mtshon cha
item.coloph: zhes las sbyor drag po'i brnag pa srog gi spu gri rno gcod mtshon cha'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ sprul sku rin po che'i bu chen drin can mchog g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dus mtha'i 'gro 'dren dam bde chen snying po zhes gsang mtshan nas smos pa nyid kyi las gsum kha bskang phyir/ las sbyor bsad pa'i lag len 'di ltar dgos gsungs ba'i ji ltar bka' gnang ba la brten nas rmongs pa thos chung rong phug gis/ chu 'brug gi lo'i gza' skar legs pa'i nyin/ drin chen rin po che nyid kyi drung du 'grub nas phyag tu phul ba'i byin gyis brlabs de/ 'gro don rgya cher 'grub pa'i legs smon dang bcas gnang ba'i rjes 'jug skal ldan gyis spyod cing bsgrubs pa'i (pas) bdag gzhan sems can thar pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig rmongs pa'i dbang gis ma khrol ba'i 'gal ba gang mchis skyabs yul rnams la mthol lo bshags so/ dam med rang 'dod can la i thi//
